newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity expands senior mgmt in equities unit.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity expands senior mgmt in equities unit.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Wednesday that Robert Pozen, newly appointed president of Fidelity Management & Research Company, has expanded the senior management team for its equity division.
Three Fidelity executives -- Abigail Johnson, Robert Lawrence, and Richard Spillane -- will oversee the eight fund groups. Johnson is the daughter of Fidelity Investments chairman Edward Johnson.
Effective May 1, the three become associate directors and senior vice presidents of Fidelity's equity division.
The new management team, which reports to Pozen, will focus on operational areas, including systems, trading, recruitment, research and human resources, as well as general fund oversight.

Johnson will continue as group leader of the specialized growth group; Lawrence will maintain his current position as senior vice president of Fidelity parent FMR Corp; and Spillane, an investment executive for Europe, will become group leader of the Income Growth group.
